rationale: The page's prose, figures and tables are original content, and the report is text-free with respect to third-party corpora -- it redistributes row hashes and scores, never prompts. One dependency is real and is now satisfied: the worked G0/D1 case study quotes two rows of the frozen v1_hmda2022 mortgage benchmark verbatim, and that source was licensed CC BY 4.0 on 2026-07-27 with redistribution_decision publish_text. The gate therefore authorizes publication on the licence, not on the absence of a dependency.

attribution_required.notice: MortgageGuardBench v1_hmda2022, Reza Rahimi, PhD (JazzX AI), licensed CC BY 4.0.
attribution_required.carried_in: the page colophon, rendered from papers/unified-report-html/template.html
attribution_required.why: CC BY 4.0 is permissive but conditional. Publishing the rows without the notice would breach the licence the ledger records, so the notice is a build output rather than a manual step.

history.why: The source was local_only with permits_redistribution unknown, its DATA_CARD stated that no licence had been selected, and no reviewer was on record. Publication was blocked.

history.why_it_no_longer_applies: The requirement was dissolved rather than met: build.py withheld the two quoted rows so the page carried no restricted text. That was the honest route while the licence question was open, and it is now superseded -- the dependency is declared again and satisfied on its merits.

redaction.status: Retained, not deleted. It is unnecessary for v1_hmda2022 now, but the situation recurs whenever a source's licence is unresolved, and rebuilding this under time pressure is how prompt text gets published by accident. Still fails closed with RedactionError if either quotation anchor stops matching.

quotation_budget.note: Re-baselined 8 -> 11 when the redaction was turned off. Kept because mortgage_guard_bench_2k_v0_1_0 is still local_only with permits_redistribution false, so the probes still catch 2K draft text reaching a published page.

gate.current_reason: mortgage_benchmark_v1_hmda2022 is approved for publish_text under CC BY 4.0, reviewed by Reza Rahimi, PhD on 2026-07-27. The refusal path stays under test via tests/fixtures/pages_artifact_unapproved/, which names a source that is still closed.
